origin.description: Return the elements of a character vector in collation order.
origin.usage: str_sort(x, decreasing = FALSE, na_last = TRUE, locale = "en", numeric = FALSE, ...)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A character vector to sort. A number or logical value is ordered by its character form and the original value is returned.

arguments.name: decreasing
arguments.text: FALSE, the default, sorts from lowest to highest. TRUE sorts from highest to lowest.

arguments.name: na_last
arguments.text: TRUE puts NA at the end, FALSE puts NA at the beginning, and NA drops missing strings.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: Locale used for comparisons. The default is "en" so English collation is the same on every platform.

arguments.name: numeric
arguments.text: TRUE sorts digit runs as numbers. FALSE, the default, sorts them as text.
Further collator settings, passed to stringi::stri_opts_collator().

origin.details: str_sort indexes x with stri_order, so a leading U+FEFF stays on the original string. The sort is stable. Ties keep their original order. The default locale is English.
origin.value: The original elements in collation order. The result is shorter when na_last is NA. NULL stays NULL.

translation.description: Return the elements of a character vector in collation order.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A string, NA, a number, a logical value, or a list of those. None is NULL and stays None.

arguments.name: decreasing
arguments.text: False sorts from lowest to highest. True sorts from highest to lowest.

arguments.name: na_last
arguments.text: True puts NA at the end, False puts NA at the beginning, and NA drops missing strings.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: Locale used for comparisons. The default is "en".

arguments.name: numeric
arguments.text: True sorts digit runs as numbers. False sorts them as text.

arguments.name: kwargs
arguments.text: Further settings passed to stri_opts_collator, such as strength, french, and uppercase_first.

translation.details: The permutation comes from stri_order and is applied to the original values. A leading U+FEFF stays, and a number stays a number. The default locale is English. Results are lists. NA is stringi._na.NA.
translation.value: A list of the original elements in collation order. None when x is None. An empty vector is an empty list.
